item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00258","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C04","C09","C17"],"selected_candidate_label":"C04","confidence":0.93,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C04 plausibly supplied a material template for the child. Both letters commission a foreign-economic investigation intended to strengthen allied economies and inform future policy, identify the assignee's qualifications, specify subjects for examination, request recommendations on a near-term schedule, and promise cooperation from relevant departments and agencies. The child adapts C04's domestically based trade-policy study into an on-the-ground European industrial mission led by the Secretary of Commerce. C09 has similar survey, interagency-cooperation, reporting, and deadline machinery, but concerns regional natural resources and is less closely matched. C17 likewise directs the Secretary of Commerce to conduct an economic study supporting later recommendations by a deadline, but its machinery and scope are narrower.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"an examination of conditions and prospects in Europe might be a desirable complement to that survey","parent_excerpt":"ask that the Board undertake an investigation of the foreign trade policies of the United States, particularly as they affect our efforts under the Mutual Security Program","explanation":"Both frame a newly commissioned foreign-economic inquiry as necessary to complement existing policy work."},{"child_excerpt":"The success of our effort toward world peace depends substantially ... upon the continued economic stability of our allies. We need strong and prosperous economies both here and abroad to protect and maintain the free nations.","parent_excerpt":"our efforts under the Mutual Security Program to achieve economic strength and solvency among the free nations","explanation":"The child closely carries forward C04's rationale linking foreign trade and economic strength among allied free nations to mutual security."},{"child_excerpt":"should head up a group who will review on the ground in Europe industrial problems and progress, with particular emphasis upon and attention to our business relations abroad","parent_excerpt":"I want you to consider all aspects of our foreign trade policy as coming within the scope of your investigation. In particular, I think you should examine...","explanation":"Both use an assignment followed by specified areas of emphasis to define an economic-policy study."},{"child_excerpt":"your conclusions and recommendations may be available before the end of this calendar year","parent_excerpt":"study this problem and recommend to the President and the Congress the course we should follow in our trade policy","explanation":"Both seek findings and recommendations as a basis for subsequent policy guidance."},{"child_excerpt":"you will receive the complete cooperation of the Department of State, the Department of Defense, and the Mutual Security Agency","parent_excerpt":"I am asking all the departments and agencies concerned with trade matters to give you full cooperation and whatever assistance you may desire","explanation":"The closing cooperation directive is materially parallel and supports reuse of the administrative template."}]}
